question: Who transmitted the teaching concerning the good-eating earth-movers?
premises: The subject concerns the earth-movers who are good eaters.
inference: An earth-mover transmitted the teaching concerning the good-eating earth-movers.
uncertainties: The distinction between singular bhūcarī and plural bhūcarīṇāṃ is contextual.
plain_english: O beloved, it was told concerning the good-eating earth-movers by an earth-mover.
